summary: P1-B replaces broad descriptor-fingerprint selection with one QR-selected, phone-resolved signer binding. The authority path now runs from settings selection through pairing proof and persistent exact membership to PhoneSigner session construction. The highest-risk dependents are pairing admission, paired-phone migration, hardware-wallet discovery, and response merging. Receive-panel changes in the same desktop commit were intentionally excluded as unrelated concurrent work.
